title: Design System: Banyira MicroCredit (public site)
scope: Public marketing site only (SiteLayout, Welcome, site/*, auth shell). The signed-in app uses a separate shadcn / Instrument Sans system not described here.

display.purpose: Page h1 only; widened 122%, weight 850. 2.6rem / 3.75rem sm / 4.4rem lg on the home hero.

headline.purpose: Section h2s; widened 112%, weight 800; 1.875rem mobile to 2.6rem.

title.purpose: Heads of ruled columns and product names.

lead.purpose: Paragraph under an h1/h2, ink at 75%.

body.purpose: Running copy, 60-65ch max on reading pages.

data.purpose: Values in ruled label/value lists; tabular figures.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: White data panel or auth card on a lake ground.

motion.name: sms-in
motion.value: 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) forwards; opacity 0 to 1, translateY(10px) to none
motion.purpose: Hero phone bubbles, played once, staggered 0.3s / 1.3s / 2.4s.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation and transition durations 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion

components.css: .ds-phone { margin: 0; max-width: 22rem; font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #14212b; } .ds-phone-body { background: #14212b; border-radius: 2rem; padding: 12px; box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -30px rgba(20,33,43,0.6); } .ds-phone-screen { background: #e6efee; border-radius: 1.5rem; padding: 16px 16px 20px; display: grid; gap: 12px; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-bubble { margin: 0; display: flex; gap: 10px; background: #fff; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); animation: ds-sms-in 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1) both; } .ds-bubble-done { background: #0a7553; color: #fff; font-weight: 600; animation-delay: 1s; } .ds-dot { flex: none; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-top: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #e8b931; } .ds-phone figcaption { margin-top: 16px; text-align: center; font-size: 14px; color: rgba(20,33,43,0.65); } @keyframes ds-sms-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-bubble { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The site plays the category standard straight: a white page, dark ink, one leaf green for every action, and the cost of a loan shown as a plain ruled statement rather than as headline numbers. The only voice raised above that is the headline type. Archivo is widened (122% on display, 112% on headings) and set very heavy, so headlines read like a painted shop signboard while everything beneath them stays an ordinary, readable bank page. It works on a low-end Android phone first and then opens out to two columns on desktop.

Structure does the work that decoration would do on other sites. Sections take turns between white and a pale lake tint, and the investor band and the calculator sit on full-width ink. Content groups open with a heavy 3px ink rule instead of a card box. Figures sit in ruled definition lists with tabular numerals. The one moving element is the hero phone, which plays the SMS-to-acceptance exchange once and then stays still.

The world was chosen against gimmick: no pattern fills, no gradients, no eyebrow labels above headings, no grids of icon tiles.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, ink text, one green for action; lake for alternate sections; ink bands for the investor and calculator moments.
Widened, heavy Archivo headlines over plain Archivo body at normal width.
3px ink top rules open columns, tables, FAQ groups and the auth card.
Money shown as ruled label/value rows with tabular figures, never as big standalone stats.
Underlined text links as the secondary action next to every primary button.
Bilingual (English / Chichewa) with the switch always visible.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Leaf means "act" or "money to you". If something is green, it is a button, a link, a check against a term, or the amount received. Never use it as decoration.

rules.name: The Maize Is a Signal Rule
rules.body: Maize lights the unread SMS dot and focus on ink. It never fills a surface, a button or a headline.

rules.name: The Lake Then Ink Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Full-width sections alternate between white and lake. Ink is saved for the one or two moments per page that need a change of key (investors, the calculator, the Support search, the footer).

rules.name: The Two Widths Rule
rules.body: Only headings are widened (display at 122%, headings and the wordmark at 112%, buttons at 108%). Body, data and labels stay at 100%. Never widen running text.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every money figure, rate and count in a list or output is set with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Sections, columns, lists and buttons never cast shadows. A shadow means "this object sits on top of the page", and there should be no more than one such object per section.

dos: Do use leaf for every primary action and pair it with one underlined text link as the secondary path.
Do open content groups with a 3px ink top rule and divide their rows with ink-hairline (ink at 10%).
Do show cost as a ruled statement of label/value rows with tabular figures, inside a white 8px data panel.
Do alternate full-width sections between white and lake, and reserve ink bands for the investor moment, the calculator, the Support search and the footer.
Do widen headings only (122% display, 112% headings) and keep body text at normal width.
Do keep text at ink 65% or darker on light grounds.
Do use a 3px ink focus outline on light grounds and a 3px maize one on ink.
Do caption every illustrative example (the hero phone, worked costs) as fictional or illustrative.
donts: Don't put eyebrow labels or kickers above headings; the heading stands alone.
Don't use gradients, pattern fills or textured grounds.
Don't build grids of icon tiles or boxed cards; use ruled columns and step numerals.
Don't use maize anywhere except the unread SMS dot and focus on ink.
Don't cast shadows from sections, columns, lists or buttons; only a single floating object (phone, panel on lake, auth card, dropdown) gets lift.
Don't use unset-red for anything except a site setting that has not been configured yet.
Don't apply this system to the signed-in app, which keeps its own shadcn / Instrument Sans system.
